_comment: Seven beats. captionText is what a judge reads on screen and carries the exact figures. speechText is the same sentence spelled for a text to speech engine, so AWS becomes A W S and EU becomes E U. Run video/generate-narration.py once and read the total it prints before planning around any length: it refuses outside 90 to 174 seconds and tells you the measured figure.

segments._beat: The problem, in the words of the person who has it. One named person, never a market.
segments.captionText: Elena manages a home in Munich. When her Bosch washer failed at month 22, the retailer claimed the one-year guarantee expired. Under European Directive 2019/771, sellers are strictly liable for 24 months. Elena paid 185 EUR out-of-pocket because nobody holds the legal calendar.
